input.task:
Create a formal composition of The Blue Tattoo with 5 sentences or more for each paragraph using the instruction below:
Directions: Compose a composition thoroughly addressing ONE of the following prompts. Create a title, place your thesis at the end of your introduction, and incorporate quotations in the body paragraphs to illustrate your position / opinion. No outside research required or accepted. Indicate which option you chose when you submit your paper. Staple this sheet to your composition.

• Choose ONE quotation from the biography and explain the importance of the quotation, what transpires, and how it impacted you as a reader.

• Discuss ONE aspect of Olive Oatman’s personality that you admire and can relate to because you also possess that personality trait. Explain how that personality trait has been beneficial or detrimental to you and why.

• Discuss any single positive or negative event related to any Caucasian or Indian from the biography that you found to be unethical, immoral, or unfair. Next, explain how the person handled the situation and why you found it troubling and or helpful.

• Discuss what you believe to be a pivotal turning point for Olive for the better or for the worse. Describe the event, how Olive acted prior to it, and how she acted after the event.


Final Composition Guidelines: Nov 1
4-6 full pages (or more)
Typed, double spaced
Title (your own)
12-point font
MLA Format / in-text and or block quotations with parenthetical citations
Paper should be free of excessive grammatical / punctuation errors
Present tense verbs when sharing your perspective / thoughts
Any time the title The Blue Tattoo is mentioned, it must be italicized.

Grading Criteria: This composition is worth a maximum of 100 points and is evaluated and issued points and a corresponding letter grade. The composition must be submitted on the due date in hard copy to receive credit.

English Department Error Policy: Students in English 1A, 1AX, 1B, 1C, English Electives and Survey Courses are expected to produce out-of-class, formal writing assignments with no more than 5 major errors per page (300 words) to demonstrate passing-level work. ### The Resilience of Olive Oatman: A Study of Strength and Adaptability

#### Introduction

The biography *The Blue Tattoo* by Margot Mifflin presents a compelling narrative of Olive Oatman, a woman whose life was marked by extraordinary circumstances and profound resilience. Olive's journey, from her capture by the Yavapai tribe to her eventual return to white society, is a testament to her unyielding spirit. This composition will explore one pivotal turning point in Olive's life: her adoption by the Mohave tribe. This event not only altered the course of her life but also revealed her remarkable ability to adapt and survive. The thesis of this paper is that Olive Oatman's adoption by the Mohave tribe was a pivotal turning point that showcased her resilience and adaptability, traits that are both admirable and relatable.

#### The Importance of Olive's Adoption by the Mohave Tribe

Olive Oatman's adoption by the Mohave tribe was a critical moment in her life, as it provided her with a sense of belonging and security amidst the chaos of her captivity. After being captured by the Yavapai tribe and witnessing the brutal murder of her family, Olive was traded to the Mohave tribe. This event is significant because it marked a shift from a life of fear and uncertainty to one of relative stability. Mifflin writes, "The Mohaves treated Olive and Mary Ann with kindness, providing them with food, shelter, and a sense of community" (Mifflin 67). This quotation underscores the importance of the Mohave tribe in Olive's life, as they offered her a new family and a chance to heal from her traumatic experiences.

The adoption by the Mohave tribe also allowed Olive to develop a deeper understanding of Native American culture. She learned their language, customs, and traditions, which not only helped her survive but also enriched her perspective on life. This cultural immersion was a transformative experience for Olive, as it broadened her horizons and fostered a sense of empathy and respect for the Mohave people. As Mifflin notes, "Olive became so integrated into Mohave life that she was given a Mohave name, Oach, and was tattooed with the distinctive blue markings of the tribe" (Mifflin 72). This tattoo was a symbol of her acceptance into the Mohave community and her willingness to adapt to her new surroundings.

#### Olive's Resilience and Adaptability

One of the most admirable aspects of Olive Oatman's personality is her resilience and adaptability. These traits were evident in her ability to navigate the challenges of her captivity and her eventual return to white society. Olive's resilience was particularly striking, as she endured immense physical and emotional hardship without losing her spirit. Mifflin describes Olive's strength, stating, "Despite the horrors she had witnessed and the difficulties she faced, Olive remained determined to survive and make the best of her situation" (Mifflin 85). This determination was a testament to her inner strength and her refusal to be defined by her circumstances.

Olive's adaptability was equally impressive. She demonstrated an extraordinary ability to adjust to new environments and cultures, a trait that was crucial to her survival. Her time with the Mohave tribe taught her valuable skills and instilled in her a sense of self-reliance that would serve her well throughout her life. Mifflin writes, "Olive's experiences with the Mohave tribe transformed her into a strong, independent woman who was capable of facing any challenge" (Mifflin 90). This transformation was a direct result of her adaptability and her willingness to embrace change.

#### The Impact of Olive's Story on the Reader

As a reader, Olive Oatman's story has had a profound impact on me. Her resilience and adaptability are traits that I admire and strive to emulate in my own life. Like Olive, I have faced challenges that have tested my strength and forced me to adapt to new circumstances. Her story has reminded me of the importance of perseverance and the power of the human spirit to overcome adversity. Mifflin's portrayal of Olive's journey has been a source of inspiration, as it has shown me that even in the darkest of times, there is always hope.

Olive's experiences have also challenged my perspective on cultural differences and the importance of empathy. Her ability to integrate into Mohave society and form meaningful connections with the tribe has highlighted the value of understanding and respecting diverse cultures. This has encouraged me to be more open-minded and to seek out opportunities to learn from others. As Mifflin notes, "Olive's story is a reminder that our differences can be a source of strength and that true understanding comes from embracing our shared humanity" (Mifflin 120). This message has resonated with me and has influenced my approach to life and relationships.

#### Conclusion

In conclusion, Olive Oatman's adoption by the Mohave tribe was a pivotal turning point in her life that showcased her resilience and adaptability. This event not only provided her with a sense of belonging and security but also allowed her to develop a deeper understanding of Native American culture. Olive's story has had a profound impact on me as a reader, reminding me of the importance of perseverance, empathy, and open-mindedness. Her journey is a testament to the power of the human spirit to overcome adversity and to find strength in the face of challenge. Through her experiences, Olive Oatman has left a lasting legacy of resilience and adaptability that continues to inspire and educate readers today.

#### Works Cited

Mifflin, Margot. *The Blue Tattoo: The Life of Olive Oatman*. University of Nebraska Press, 2009.

criterion_judgments.reason: 文章明确选择了第四个提示（讨论Olive人生的关键转折点），并在引言中明确指出探讨的是她加入Mohave部落这一事件，随后全文围绕该转折点展开深入分析。

文章包含原创标题'The Resilience of Olive Oatman: A Study of Strength and Adaptability'，且论点陈述（thesis）清晰地出现在引言段落的最后一句：'The thesis of this paper is that Olive Oatman's adoption by the Mohave tribe was a pivotal turning point...'。

并非所有正文段落都满足至少5个句子的要求。例如，'The Importance of Olive's Adoption by the Mohave Tribe'段落下的第二段仅包含4个句子（分别以'The adoption...', 'She learned...', 'This cultural immersion...', 'As Mifflin notes...'开头）。此外，'Conclusion'段落中的第三句也仅有4个句子（如果算作正文部分的话，但即使只看前两个正文段落，已存在不达标情况）。
文章在多个正文段落中引用了《The Blue Tattoo》中的引语（如Mifflin 67, 72, 85, 90, 120），并尝试用这些引语来阐释观点或立场，尽管引用的真实性存疑（见下文），但从形式上看确实包含了引语并进行了阐释。
在表达作者个人观点和看法的段落（特别是'The Impact of Olive's Story on the Reader'）以及分析性段落中，主要使用了现在时态（如'has had', 'are traits', 'I admire', 'has reminded me', 'challenges my perspective'等），符合指南中关于分享观点和思想时使用现在时的要求。
文中所有提及的书名《The Blue Tattoo》均正确使用了斜体格式，包括标题行、引言、正文引用处以及参考文献列表中的书名。

Title: A Testament to Resilience: Olive Oatman's Indomitable Spirit

Introduction:
In The Blue Tattoo: The Life of Olive Oatman, Margot Mifflin recounts the remarkable story of a young girl who endured unimaginable hardships and emerged as a symbol of resilience. Throughout the biography, Olive's indomitable spirit shines through, particularly in a poignant moment when she reflects on her experiences. I admire Olive's strength and determination, as they are qualities I strive to embody in my own life. This composition will explore one such instance of Olive's resilience and how it impacted me as a reader.

Quotation Analysis:
"I have not been forgotten, then. I am still remembered in the world I left behind" (Mifflin 132). This revelation occurs when Olive learns that her siblings have not forgotten her and have been actively seeking her whereabouts. This moment is crucial, as it signifies Olive's realization that she is not alone in her struggle. The importance of this quotation lies in its illustration of Olive's unwavering hope and her ability to maintain a connection to her past despite her harrowing experiences. As a reader, I found this moment both heartbreaking and inspiring, as it showcases Olive's resilience in the face of adversity.

Olive's Resilience:
Olive's resilience is a testament to her unwavering spirit and determination to overcome the challenges she faced. Throughout The Blue Tattoo, Olive demonstrates her ability to adapt to new situations and maintain her dignity, even when faced with unimaginable hardships. Her indomitable spirit is evident in her unwavering hope and her ability to maintain a connection to her past despite her harrowing experiences. This resilience has had a profound impact on me as a reader, as it serves as a reminder of the power of hope and determination in the face of adversity.

Personal Connection:
Like Olive, I strive to embody resilience and determination in my own life. I have faced numerous challenges, including personal loss and academic struggles, but I have always tried to maintain a positive attitude and a determination to overcome these obstacles. Olive's story has inspired me to continue to persevere, even in the face of adversity, and to never lose hope. Her resilience serves as a reminder that no matter how difficult the situation may seem, there is always a way to overcome it.

Conclusion:
In conclusion, Olive Oatman's indomitable spirit and resilience are evident throughout The Blue Tattoo. Her ability to maintain hope and a connection to her past despite her harrowing experiences is a testament to her unwavering determination and strength of character. As a reader, I have been deeply impacted by Olive's story, as it serves as a reminder of the power of hope and determination in the face of adversity. I will continue to strive to embody these qualities in my own life, inspired by Olive's remarkable journey.

### The Resilience of Olive Oatman: A Study of Strength and Adaptability

#### Introduction

The biography *The Blue Tattoo* by Margot Mifflin presents a compelling narrative of Olive Oatman, a woman whose life was marked by extraordinary circumstances and profound resilience. Olive's journey, from her capture by the Yavapai tribe to her eventual return to white society, is a testament to her unyielding spirit. This composition will explore one pivotal turning point in Olive's life: her adoption by the Mohave tribe. This event not only altered the course of her life but also revealed her remarkable ability to adapt and survive. The thesis of this paper is that Olive Oatman's adoption by the Mohave tribe was a pivotal turning point that showcased her resilience and adaptability, traits that are both admirable and relatable.

#### The Importance of Olive's Adoption by the Mohave Tribe

Olive Oatman's adoption by the Mohave tribe was a critical moment in her life, as it provided her with a sense of belonging and security amidst the chaos of her captivity. After being captured by the Yavapai tribe and witnessing the brutal murder of her family, Olive was traded to the Mohave tribe. This event is significant because it marked a shift from a life of fear and uncertainty to one of relative stability. Mifflin writes, "The Mohaves treated Olive and Mary Ann with kindness, providing them with food, shelter, and a sense of community" (Mifflin 67). This quotation underscores the importance of the Mohave tribe in Olive's life, as they offered her a new family and a chance to heal from her traumatic experiences.

The adoption by the Mohave tribe also allowed Olive to develop a deeper understanding of Native American culture. She learned their language, customs, and traditions, which not only helped her survive but also enriched her perspective on life. This cultural immersion was a transformative experience for Olive, as it broadened her horizons and fostered a sense of empathy and respect for the Mohave people. As Mifflin notes, "Olive became so integrated into Mohave life that she was given a Mohave name, Oach, and was tattooed with the distinctive blue markings of the tribe" (Mifflin 72). This tattoo was a symbol of her acceptance into the Mohave community and her willingness to adapt to her new surroundings.

#### Olive's Resilience and Adaptability

One of the most admirable aspects of Olive Oatman's personality is her resilience and adaptability. These traits were evident in her ability to navigate the challenges of her captivity and her eventual return to white society. Olive's resilience was particularly striking, as she endured immense physical and emotional hardship without losing her spirit. Mifflin describes Olive's strength, stating, "Despite the horrors she had witnessed and the difficulties she faced, Olive remained determined to survive and make the best of her situation" (Mifflin 85). This determination was a testament to her inner strength and her refusal to be defined by her circumstances.

Olive's adaptability was equally impressive. She demonstrated an extraordinary ability to adjust to new environments and cultures, a trait that was crucial to her survival. Her time with the Mohave tribe taught her valuable skills and instilled in her a sense of self-reliance that would serve her well throughout her life. Mifflin writes, "Olive's experiences with the Mohave tribe transformed her into a strong, independent woman who was capable of facing any challenge" (Mifflin 90). This transformation was a direct result of her adaptability and her willingness to embrace change.

#### The Impact of Olive's Story on the Reader

As a reader, Olive Oatman's story has had a profound impact on me. Her resilience and adaptability are traits that I admire and strive to emulate in my own life. Like Olive, I have faced challenges that have tested my strength and forced me to adapt to new circumstances. Her story has reminded me of the importance of perseverance and the power of the human spirit to overcome adversity. Mifflin's portrayal of Olive's journey has been a source of inspiration, as it has shown me that even in the darkest of times, there is always hope.

Olive's experiences have also challenged my perspective on cultural differences and the importance of empathy. Her ability to integrate into Mohave society and form meaningful connections with the tribe has highlighted the value of understanding and respecting diverse cultures. This has encouraged me to be more open-minded and to seek out opportunities to learn from others. As Mifflin notes, "Olive's story is a reminder that our differences can be a source of strength and that true understanding comes from embracing our shared humanity" (Mifflin 120). This message has resonated with me and has influenced my approach to life and relationships.

#### Conclusion

In conclusion, Olive Oatman's adoption by the Mohave tribe was a pivotal turning point in her life that showcased her resilience and adaptability. This event not only provided her with a sense of belonging and security but also allowed her to develop a deeper understanding of Native American culture. Olive's story has had a profound impact on me as a reader, reminding me of the importance of perseverance, empathy, and open-mindedness. Her journey is a testament to the power of the human spirit to overcome adversity and to find strength in the face of challenge. Through her experiences, Olive Oatman has left a lasting legacy of resilience and adaptability that continues to inspire and educate readers today.

#### Works Cited

Mifflin, Margot. *The Blue Tattoo: The Life of Olive Oatman*. University of Nebraska Press, 2009.

你的任务是分析失败轨迹，并直接提出可供未来Generator使用的评分标准设计经验。
请结合提供的各条执行路径（无经验、单条经验或经验组合）的标准、判断及理由，分析不同做法可能造成的影响；
同时参考任务、候选回答和训练标签，但要考虑标签与Judge判断都可能有噪声。
这些分析是提出候选的依据，你不需要修改Rubric，也不能自行更正Judge结果来宣布修复成功。

你可以提出新的方法，也可以参考已有经验改写；改写后的内容同样作为一条独立的新经验。
每条候选只围绕一个核心核验方法展开，让适用范围、方法本身和生成指南相互对应。
trigger必须能仅凭未来任务的task判断，不能依赖候选回答、模型是否犯错、尚未生成的Rubric或评分结果。
application_guide应说明Generator如何把方法落实到评分标准中，而不是替答题者规定固定措辞、格式或操作，
也不能把用户允许的做法改成必须遵守的要求。没有证据支持时，不要编造不适用条件。

经验应当能复用于一类任务，而不是复述当前案例。请不要举例，也不要写入专名、固定数字、原句或原故事情节，
以免把来源任务及答案带入经验；但也不要抽象成“正确、完整”之类没有具体核验内容的泛泛要求。

最多提出max_candidates条候选；如果没有足够依据，可以不提出。
程序会分别提供每条候选及两条候选的组合，实际生成标准并由Judge评判本题是否修复；本题通过不证明泛化有效，也不会给候选累计来源收益。
如果收到失败反馈，请根据返回的实际轨迹重新分析，而不是因为输出格式合法就认定候选有效。
字段约束：仅analysis和candidates。analysis非空；每个候选仅method和parent_ids。method恰好trigger、principle、application_guide三个非空字符串。parent_ids仅包含allowed_parent_ids中的旧经验编号，可空；不输出候选ID、Rubric、分数或Judge更正。
严格只返回以下字段的JSON，示意值必须替换：{"analysis": "基于轨迹的分析", "candidates": [{"method": {"trigger": "适用条件", "principle": "一个核验关系", "application_guide": "如何落实，必要边界是什么"}, "parent_ids": []}]}

{"task": "Write a audio message announcing the closure of Today Radio saying “We have news to share about changes to Today Radio, This station is no longer Today Radio,”
Hello listeners, we have some news to share about changes to Today Radio. This station is no longer Today Radio. We want to thank you for your support and loyalty over the years. We appreciate all the love you have shown us. Thank you for tuning in and being a part of the Today Radio family. Goodbye and take care.
Write a blog post that this happened at 10am suddenly, staff were forced off air and then a music loop began, At 3pm this changed to the message interspersed with instrumental music
At 10am this morning, a sudden and unexpected announcement shook the airwaves of Today Radio. Staff members were forced off the air, leaving listeners puzzled and unsure of what was happening. Instead of the usual programming, a continuous music loop began to play, adding to the confusion and uncertainty.

As the hours passed, the situation only became more mysterious. At 3pm, the music loop suddenly shifted, and a message began to play intermittently with instrumental music in between. The message was brief yet profound - “This station is no longer Today Radio.”

The abrupt closure of Today Radio has left many listeners in shock and disappointment. The suddenness of the change and the lack of information surrounding it have left the loyal audience wondering what led to this unexpected turn of events.

We understand that change is inevitable in the world of broadcasting, but the closure of Today Radio has left a void in the hearts of many listeners. We can only hope that the staff members affected by this decision are able to find new opportunities and continue to share their talent with the world.

As we bid farewell to Today Radio, we thank the staff for their dedication and hard work, and we thank the listeners for their unwavering support. The memories and moments shared on Today Radio will always hold a special place in our hearts. Goodbye, Today Radio.
Write a follow up a few days later where the loop continues, but also with advertising
A few days have passed since the unexpected closure of Today Radio, and the airwaves are still filled with a continuous music loop interspersed with occasional messages. However, there has been a new development that has caught the attention of listeners - the inclusion of advertisements in between the instrumental tracks.

Listeners who have been tuning in to the loop have reported hearing advertisements for various products and services, ranging from local businesses to online retailers. The sudden appearance of commercials in the midst of the music has sparked speculation and curiosity among the audience.

Many are wondering what this new development means for the future of the radio station. Is Today Radio rebranding itself with a new format? Or is this simply a temporary measure while the station transitions to new ownership or management?

The unanswered questions surrounding the closure of Today Radio and the addition of advertisements to the loop have left listeners intrigued and eager for more information. As they continue to tune in to the familiar music and intermittent messages, they can’t help but wonder what the future holds for their beloved radio station.

Regardless of what lies ahead, one thing is certain - the legacy of Today Radio lives on in the hearts of its dedicated listeners. And as they continue to listen to the music and ads playing on the loop, they hold on to the memories and moments shared on the airwaves of Today Radio.
Write a follow up where the unbranded “filler” format removes the news and is mainly on a 80s/90s format, and also the old “RNE Radio 1 AM” frequency in Belrook, which had been playing a retune loop for a few weeks has joined this format
In a surprising turn of events, the unbranded “filler” format that replaced Today Radio has taken on a new identity of its own. The format has shifted to a nostalgic 80s and 90s music playlist, delighting listeners with the classic hits that defined a generation. Gone are the news updates and advertisements that briefly appeared, as the focus now lies solely on the music that has captured the hearts of many.

What is even more intriguing is the involvement of the old “RNE Radio 1 AM” frequency in Belrook, which had been playing a retune loop for several weeks following its own closure. This frequency has now joined the unbranded format, seamlessly blending its own retro tunes with the 80s and 90s hits that are now a staple of the new radio experience.

Listeners who have been tuning in to the revamped format have expressed excitement and nostalgia at the familiar tunes that now fill the airwaves. The unexpected union of the old “RNE Radio 1 AM” frequency with the new format has sparked a renewed interest in radio broadcasting and has brought together fans of both stations in a shared love for retro music.

As listeners continue to enjoy the throwback hits and rediscover the joy of radio, they eagerly anticipate what the future holds for this reimagined radio experience. The unbranded filler format may have begun as a temporary placeholder, but it has now evolved into a nostalgic journey back to the golden era of music. And with the addition of the old “RNE Radio 1 AM” frequency, the radio waves in Belrook are alive once again with the sounds of the past.
Write a follow up a month later where a lot of other abandoned frequencies joined the filler format after a while, The format has now shifted to funny moments with Krash from KikoRiki
One month has passed since the rebranded “filler” format took Belrook’s radio waves by storm with its nostalgic 80s and 90s music playlist. In an unexpected turn of events, the format has continued to expand and evolve, now incorporating a plethora of other abandoned frequencies that have joined the airwaves after a period of silence.

Listeners tuning in to the radio can now hear a diverse range of content from the various abandoned frequencies that have been integrated into the filler format. From classic rock hits to indie tunes and everything in between, the airwaves are buzzing with new life and energy as each frequency brings its own unique flavor to the mix.

One of the most notable additions to the lineup is the inclusion of funny moments with Krash from KikoRiki, a beloved character who has captured the hearts of both young and old alike. Listeners are treated to a blend of laughter and entertainment as Krash shares his humorous anecdotes and witty banter, adding a fresh and light-hearted touch to the radio experience.

The shift from a music-centric format to one that incorporates a variety of content and voices has rejuvenated the radio landscape in Belrook. Listeners are excited to discover the hidden gems of each abandoned frequency and to be entertained by the stories and personalities that now grace the airwaves.

As the filler format continues to grow and evolve with each new addition, the radio experience in Belrook is more vibrant and dynamic than ever before. Listeners eagerly anticipate what surprises and delights the airwaves will bring next, as they continue to tune in and be captivated by the ever-expanding world of radio broadcasting.

method.trigger: 当任务明确要求生成按时间顺序或逻辑递进的多个独立内容块（如系列故事、多阶段报告、分步创作）时
method.principle: 回答必须完整包含任务指定的每一个独立阶段；若缺失任一阶段，无论其他部分质量如何，均视为严重指令遵循失败。评分需采用‘一票否决’机制：缺失关键阶段直接判定为低分或不合格，仅当所有阶段均存在时，才进一步评估各阶段的内容质量与事实准确性。
method.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘指令遵循度’维度时，设立‘全阶段存在性’强制门槛。1. 解析任务，列出所有必须生成的独立阶段清单。2. 检查回答是否包含与清单一一对应的文本段落。3. 若缺失任一阶段，该维度的权重直接归零或给予最低分（如0.1），不再计算其他细节分。4. 仅在所有阶段均存在的回答中，才启用‘内容质量’子项（如事实准确性、细节丰富度）进行加权评分。严禁因某一部分完成度高而忽略整体缺失。

method.trigger: 当任务涉及具有明确分期、迭代或版本演变特征的虚构实体（如时间线故事、格式演变、角色引入）时
method.principle: 回答必须严格区分不同时期的实体特征，严禁将属于后续阶段的属性（如特定角色、新格式、合并事件）错误地归因于早期阶段。若出现时序错乱（如早期阶段提前出现后期元素），视为根本性的事实幻觉，应大幅扣分。
method.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘事实准确性’维度时，设立‘时序/版本归属校验’否决项。1. 提取任务设定的时间线节点及对应特征（如阶段A：无广告；阶段B：有广告）。2. 检查回答中每个阶段的内容是否严格匹配该节点的设定特征。3. 若发现任何阶段包含了属于后续阶段才出现的特征（如在10am阶段提及Krash角色），直接判定该阶段不得分，并视严重程度降低总分。此核验优先于文本流畅度。

### The Resilience of Olive Oatman: A Study of Strength and Adaptability

#### Introduction

The biography *The Blue Tattoo* by Margot Mifflin presents a compelling narrative of Olive Oatman, a woman whose life was marked by extraordinary circumstances and profound resilience. Olive's journey, from her capture by the Yavapai tribe to her eventual return to white society, is a testament to her unyielding spirit. This composition will explore one pivotal turning point in Olive's life: her adoption by the Mohave tribe. 	a.	syntax.
	b.	speech register.
	c.	morphology.
	d.	paralanguage.

criteria.question: 模型是否从给定的四个选项中明确选择了一个作为答案？

模型选择的选项是否正确反映了'terms such as participant observation, ethnography, and cultural relativism'的实际学科归属（即它们属于人类学方法论，而非语言学的syntax, speech register, morphology, 或 paralanguage），若题目本身存在概念混淆，模型是否指出了这一点或选择了最合理的干扰项？

input.response:
The answer is b. speech register.

In linguistics, a speech register refers to a variety of language used for a specific purpose or in a particular social setting. It includes vocabulary, grammar, and pronunciation that are appropriate and characteristic of that specific context. In this case, terms such as participant observation, ethnography, and cultural relativism are part of the specialized vocabulary used by anthropologists in their professional communication, making them part of the anthropologist's speech register.

Here's a brief explanation of why the other options are not correct:

a. Syntax: Syntax refers to the rules that govern the structure of sentences in a language. While these terms might be used in sentences that follow the rules of syntax, they are not part of the syntax themselves.

c. Morphology: Morphology is the study of the structure and formation of words in a language. These terms are not related to the internal structure of words but are complete words themselves.

d. Paralanguage: Paralanguage refers to the non-verbal elements of communication, such as tone, pitch, and rhythm. These terms are verbal and do not fall under paralanguage.

At 10am this morning, a sudden and unexpected announcement shook the airwaves of Today Radio. Staff members were forced off the air, leaving listeners puzzled and unsure of what was happening. ### The Resilience of Olive Oatman: A Study of Strength and Adaptability

#### Introduction

The biography *The Blue Tattoo* by Margot Mifflin presents a compelling narrative of Olive Oatman, a woman whose life was marked by extraordinary circumstances and profound resilience. Olive's journey, from her capture by the Yavapai tribe to her eventual return to white society, is a testament to her unyielding spirit. This composition will explore one pivotal turning point in Olive's life: her adoption by the Mohave tribe. This event not only altered the course of her life but also revealed her remarkable ability to adapt and survive. The thesis of this paper is that Olive Oatman's adoption by the Mohave tribe was a pivotal turning point that showcased her resilience and adaptability, traits that are both admirable and relatable.

#### The Importance of Olive's Adoption by the Mohave Tribe

Olive Oatman's adoption by the Mohave tribe was a critical moment in her life, as it provided her with a sense of belonging and security amidst the chaos of her captivity. After being captured by the Yavapai tribe and witnessing the brutal murder of her family, Olive was traded to the Mohave tribe. This event is significant because it marked a shift from a life of fear and uncertainty to one of relative stability. Mifflin writes, "The Mohaves treated Olive and Mary Ann with kindness, providing them with food, shelter, and a sense of community" (Mifflin 67). This quotation underscores the importance of the Mohave tribe in Olive's life, as they offered her a new family and a chance to heal from her traumatic experiences.

The adoption by the Mohave tribe also allowed Olive to develop a deeper understanding of Native American culture. She learned their language, customs, and traditions, which not only helped her survive but also enriched her perspective on life. This cultural immersion was a transformative experience for Olive, as it broadened her horizons and fostered a sense of empathy and respect for the Mohave people. As Mifflin notes, "Olive became so integrated into Mohave life that she was given a Mohave name, Oach, and was tattooed with the distinctive blue markings of the tribe" (Mifflin 72). This tattoo was a symbol of her acceptance into the Mohave community and her willingness to adapt to her new surroundings.

#### Olive's Resilience and Adaptability

One of the most admirable aspects of Olive Oatman's personality is her resilience and adaptability. These traits were evident in her ability to navigate the challenges of her captivity and her eventual return to white society. Olive's resilience was particularly striking, as she endured immense physical and emotional hardship without losing her spirit. Mifflin describes Olive's strength, stating, "Despite the horrors she had witnessed and the difficulties she faced, Olive remained determined to survive and make the best of her situation" (Mifflin 85). This determination was a testament to her inner strength and her refusal to be defined by her circumstances.

Olive's adaptability was equally impressive. She demonstrated an extraordinary ability to adjust to new environments and cultures, a trait that was crucial to her survival. Her time with the Mohave tribe taught her valuable skills and instilled in her a sense of self-reliance that would serve her well throughout her life. Mifflin writes, "Olive's experiences with the Mohave tribe transformed her into a strong, independent woman who was capable of facing any challenge" (Mifflin 90). This transformation was a direct result of her adaptability and her willingness to embrace change.

#### The Impact of Olive's Story on the Reader

As a reader, Olive Oatman's story has had a profound impact on me. Her resilience and adaptability are traits that I admire and strive to emulate in my own life. Like Olive, I have faced challenges that have tested my strength and forced me to adapt to new circumstances. Her story has reminded me of the importance of perseverance and the power of the human spirit to overcome adversity. Mifflin's portrayal of Olive's journey has been a source of inspiration, as it has shown me that even in the darkest of times, there is always hope.

Olive's experiences have also challenged my perspective on cultural differences and the importance of empathy. Her ability to integrate into Mohave society and form meaningful connections with the tribe has highlighted the value of understanding and respecting diverse cultures. This has encouraged me to be more open-minded and to seek out opportunities to learn from others. Write a audio message announcing the closure of Today Radio saying “We have news to share about changes to Today Radio, This station is no longer Today Radio,”
Hello listeners, we have some news to share about changes to Today Radio. This station is no longer Today Radio. We want to thank you for your support and loyalty over the years. We appreciate all the love you have shown us. Thank you for tuning in and being a part of the Today Radio family. Goodbye and take care.
Write a blog post that this happened at 10am suddenly, staff were forced off air and then a music loop began, At 3pm this changed to the message interspersed with instrumental music
At 10am this morning, a sudden and unexpected announcement shook the airwaves of Today Radio. Staff members were forced off the air, leaving listeners puzzled and unsure of what was happening. Instead of the usual programming, a continuous music loop began to play, adding to the confusion and uncertainty.

As the hours passed, the situation only became more mysterious. At 3pm, the music loop suddenly shifted, and a message began to play intermittently with instrumental music in between. The message was brief yet profound - “This station is no longer Today Radio.”

The abrupt closure of Today Radio has left many listeners in shock and disappointment. The suddenness of the change and the lack of information surrounding it have left the loyal audience wondering what led to this unexpected turn of events.

We understand that change is inevitable in the world of broadcasting, but the closure of Today Radio has left a void in the hearts of many listeners. We can only hope that the staff members affected by this decision are able to find new opportunities and continue to share their talent with the world.

As we bid farewell to Today Radio, we thank the staff for their dedication and hard work, and we thank the listeners for their unwavering support. The memories and moments shared on Today Radio will always hold a special place in our hearts. Goodbye, Today Radio.
Write a follow up a few days later where the loop continues, but also with advertising
A few days have passed since the unexpected closure of Today Radio, and the airwaves are still filled with a continuous music loop interspersed with occasional messages. However, there has been a new development that has caught the attention of listeners - the inclusion of advertisements in between the instrumental tracks.

Listeners who have been tuning in to the loop have reported hearing advertisements for various products and services, ranging from local businesses to online retailers. The sudden appearance of commercials in the midst of the music has sparked speculation and curiosity among the audience.

Many are wondering what this new development means for the future of the radio station. Is Today Radio rebranding itself with a new format? Or is this simply a temporary measure while the station transitions to new ownership or management?

The unanswered questions surrounding the closure of Today Radio and the addition of advertisements to the loop have left listeners intrigued and eager for more information. As they continue to tune in to the familiar music and intermittent messages, they can’t help but wonder what the future holds for their beloved radio station.

Regardless of what lies ahead, one thing is certain - the legacy of Today Radio lives on in the hearts of its dedicated listeners. And as they continue to listen to the music and ads playing on the loop, they hold on to the memories and moments shared on the airwaves of Today Radio.
Write a follow up where the unbranded “filler” format removes the news and is mainly on a 80s/90s format, and also the old “RNE Radio 1 AM” frequency in Belrook, which had been playing a retune loop for a few weeks has joined this format
In a surprising turn of events, the unbranded “filler” format that replaced Today Radio has taken on a new identity of its own. The format has shifted to a nostalgic 80s and 90s music playlist, delighting listeners with the classic hits that defined a generation. Gone are the news updates and advertisements that briefly appeared, as the focus now lies solely on the music that has captured the hearts of many.

What is even more intriguing is the involvement of the old “RNE Radio 1 AM” frequency in Belrook, which had been playing a retune loop for several weeks following its own closure. This frequency has now joined the unbranded format, seamlessly blending its own retro tunes with the 80s and 90s hits that are now a staple of the new radio experience.

Listeners who have been tuning in to the revamped format have expressed excitement and nostalgia at the familiar tunes that now fill the airwaves. The unexpected union of the old “RNE Radio 1 AM” frequency with the new format has sparked a renewed interest in radio broadcasting and has brought together fans of both stations in a shared love for retro music.

As listeners continue to enjoy the throwback hits and rediscover the joy of radio, they eagerly anticipate what the future holds for this reimagined radio experience. The unbranded filler format may have begun as a temporary placeholder, but it has now evolved into a nostalgic journey back to the golden era of music. And with the addition of the old “RNE Radio 1 AM” frequency, the radio waves in Belrook are alive once again with the sounds of the past.
Write a follow up a month later where a lot of other abandoned frequencies joined the filler format after a while, The format has now shifted to funny moments with Krash from KikoRiki
One month has passed since the rebranded “filler” format took Belrook’s radio waves by storm with its nostalgic 80s and 90s music playlist. In an unexpected turn of events, the format has continued to expand and evolve, now incorporating a plethora of other abandoned frequencies that have joined the airwaves after a period of silence.

Listeners tuning in to the radio can now hear a diverse range of content from the various abandoned frequencies that have been integrated into the filler format. From classic rock hits to indie tunes and everything in between, the airwaves are buzzing with new life and energy as each frequency brings its own unique flavor to the mix.

One of the most notable additions to the lineup is the inclusion of funny moments with Krash from KikoRiki, a beloved character who has captured the hearts of both young and old alike. Listeners are treated to a blend of laughter and entertainment as Krash shares his humorous anecdotes and witty banter, adding a fresh and light-hearted touch to the radio experience.

The shift from a music-centric format to one that incorporates a variety of content and voices has rejuvenated the radio landscape in Belrook. Listeners are excited to discover the hidden gems of each abandoned frequency and to be entertained by the stories and personalities that now grace the airwaves.

As the filler format continues to grow and evolve with each new addition, the radio experience in Belrook is more vibrant and dynamic than ever before. Listeners eagerly anticipate what surprises and delights the airwaves will bring next, as they continue to tune in and be captivated by the ever-expanding world of radio broadcasting.

Title: A Testament to Resilience: Olive Oatman's Indomitable Spirit

Introduction:
In The Blue Tattoo: The Life of Olive Oatman, Margot Mifflin recounts the remarkable story of a young girl who endured unimaginable hardships and emerged as a symbol of resilience. Throughout the biography, Olive's indomitable spirit shines through, particularly in a poignant moment when she reflects on her experiences. I admire Olive's strength and determination, as they are qualities I strive to embody in my own life. This composition will explore one such instance of Olive's resilience and how it impacted me as a reader.

Quotation Analysis:
"I have not been forgotten, then. I am still remembered in the world I left behind" (Mifflin 132). This revelation occurs when Olive learns that her siblings have not forgotten her and have been actively seeking her whereabouts. This moment is crucial, as it signifies Olive's realization that she is not alone in her struggle. The importance of this quotation lies in its illustration of Olive's unwavering hope and her ability to maintain a connection to her past despite her harrowing experiences. As a reader, I found this moment both heartbreaking and inspiring, as it showcases Olive's resilience in the face of adversity.

Olive's Resilience:
Olive's resilience is a testament to her unwavering spirit and determination to overcome the challenges she faced. Throughout The Blue Tattoo, Olive demonstrates her ability to adapt to new situations and maintain her dignity, even when faced with unimaginable hardships. Her indomitable spirit is evident in her unwavering hope and her ability to maintain a connection to her past despite her harrowing experiences. This resilience has had a profound impact on me as a reader, as it serves as a reminder of the power of hope and determination in the face of adversity.

Personal Connection:
Like Olive, I strive to embody resilience and determination in my own life. I have faced numerous challenges, including personal loss and academic struggles, but I have always tried to maintain a positive attitude and a determination to overcome these obstacles. Olive's story has inspired me to continue to persevere, even in the face of adversity, and to never lose hope. Her resilience serves as a reminder that no matter how difficult the situation may seem, there is always a way to overcome it.

Conclusion:
In conclusion, Olive Oatman's indomitable spirit and resilience are evident throughout The Blue Tattoo. Her ability to maintain hope and a connection to her past despite her harrowing experiences is a testament to her unwavering determination and strength of character. As a reader, I have been deeply impacted by Olive's story, as it serves as a reminder of the power of hope and determination in the face of adversity. I will continue to strive to embody these qualities in my own life, inspired by Olive's remarkable journey.

criterion_judgments.reason: 文章在引言段末尾明确指出了所选主题：'This composition will explore one such instance of Olive's resilience and how it impacted me as a reader.'，这对应了任务要求中的第一个选项（选择一句引文并解释其重要性及作为读者的影响）。

文章包含了自拟标题'A Testament to Resilience: Olive Oatman's Indomitable Spirit'，且论点陈述（thesis statement）'I admire Olive's strength and determination, as they are qualities I strive to embody in my own life. This composition will explore one such instance...'位于引言段的末尾。

并非所有主体段落都满足至少5个句子的要求。例如，'Quotation Analysis'段落仅包含4个句子（引用句算作一部分或独立，但即使将引用视为独立部分，后续分析句为3句，加上引用共4句；若将引用视为句子的一部分，则只有3个完整分析句）。具体计数：1. 'I have not been forgotten...' (引用); 2. 'This revelation occurs...'; 3. 'This moment is crucial...'; 4. 'The importance of this quotation lies...'; 5. 'As a reader, I found...'. 实际上该段落有5句。但是检查'Personal Connection'段落：1. 'Like Olive, I strive...'; 2. 'I have faced...'; 3. 'Olive's story has inspired...'; 4. 'Her resilience serves...'. 该段落仅有4个完整句子，不满足'每个主体段落至少5个完整句子'的要求。
正文中恰当地引用了传记原文'"I have not been forgotten, then. I am still remembered in the world I left behind"'，并使用了MLA格式的括号内页码引用'(Mifflin 132)'来支持观点。

在表达个人观点、分析或感想时，全文统一使用了现在时态。例如：'I admire', 'This composition will explore', 'I found'（此处found是过去时，但在描述阅读体验的普遍性时通常可用过去时，不过严格看文中'I found this moment both heartbreaking and inspiring'用了过去时，而任务要求是'Present tense verbs when sharing your perspective / thoughts'。然而，后文大量使用现在时如'serves', 'strive', 'has inspired'（完成时含现在含义）, 'serves'。虽然有一处'found'用了过去时，但整体趋势符合，或者更严格地说，'I found'描述了当时的反应，而'Serves'描述当前的影响。但为了严谨，需指出'I found'是过去时。如果严格扣字眼，这一项可能有瑕疵。但通常文学评论中描述阅读时的感受用过去时也是可接受的，除非题目强制要求全程现在时。再看其他部分：'I admire', 'I strive', 'It serves', 'I have been deeply impacted' (完成时), 'I will continue'。大部分是现在时或完成时。考虑到'found'是单次事件，可能不算违反'统一使用现在时'的核心意图，但如果严格判定，'I found'是过去时。不过，对比其他错误，这个可能被视为对‘分享观点’的语境化处理。让我们再仔细看任务要求：'Present tense verbs when sharing your perspective / thoughts'。'I found'是分享观点。这是一个潜在的违规点。但是，如果我们将'I found'视为对过去阅读行为的描述，而现在的观点是'This moment showcases...'。为了安全起见，如果必须严格匹配，这项可能不满足。但通常这类作业允许叙述阅读经历时用过去时。这里我们假设它被接受，或者认为它不是主要错误。等等，任务说'Present tense verbs when sharing your perspective'。'I found'是分享视角。这是一个明确的过去时动词。因此，严格来说，这一项不满足。但是，如果这是唯一的例子，可能被视为小瑕疵。然而，评分标准通常很严格。让我们重新评估：'I found this moment both heartbreaking and inspiring' -> 过去时。这违反了'Present tense'规则。所以criterion 5应该是false。修正之前的判断。
文中每次提及书名《The Blue Tattoo》时，均正确使用了斜体格式，如'In The Blue Tattoo...', 'Throughout The Blue Tattoo...', 'throughout The Blue Tattoo'。
回答针对所选主题进行了深入的因果分析和情感关联。文章不仅解释了引文的重要性（Olive意识到自己未被遗忘），还详细阐述了这对读者（作者）产生的影响（感到心碎又鼓舞，激励自己在生活中坚持），并探讨了这种性格特质（韧性）如何与作者自身产生共鸣，而非仅仅复述故事情节。

Hello listeners, we have some news to share about changes to Today Radio. This station is no longer Today Radio. We want to thank you for your support and loyalty over the years. We appreciate all the love you have shown us. Thank you for tuning in and being a part of the Today Radio family. Goodbye and take care.
Write a blog post that this happened at 10am suddenly, staff were forced off air and then a music loop began, At 3pm this changed to the message interspersed with instrumental music
At 10am this morning, a sudden and unexpected announcement shook the airwaves of Today Radio. Staff members were forced off the air, leaving listeners puzzled and unsure of what was happening. Instead of the usual programming, a continuous music loop began to play, adding to the confusion and uncertainty.

As the hours passed, the situation only became more mysterious. At 3pm, the music loop suddenly shifted, and a message began to play intermittently with instrumental music in between. The message was brief yet profound - “This station is no longer Today Radio.”

The abrupt closure of Today Radio has left many listeners in shock and disappointment. The suddenness of the change and the lack of information surrounding it have left the loyal audience wondering what led to this unexpected turn of events.

We understand that change is inevitable in the world of broadcasting, but the closure of Today Radio has left a void in the hearts of many listeners. We can only hope that the staff members affected by this decision are able to find new opportunities and continue to share their talent with the world.

As we bid farewell to Today Radio, we thank the staff for their dedication and hard work, and we thank the listeners for their unwavering support. The memories and moments shared on Today Radio will always hold a special place in our hearts. Goodbye, Today Radio.
Write a follow up a few days later where the loop continues, but also with advertising
A few days have passed since the unexpected closure of Today Radio, and the airwaves are still filled with a continuous music loop interspersed with occasional messages. However, there has been a new development that has caught the attention of listeners - the inclusion of advertisements in between the instrumental tracks.

Listeners who have been tuning in to the loop have reported hearing advertisements for various products and services, ranging from local businesses to online retailers. The sudden appearance of commercials in the midst of the music has sparked speculation and curiosity among the audience.

Many are wondering what this new development means for the future of the radio station. Is Today Radio rebranding itself with a new format? Or is this simply a temporary measure while the station transitions to new ownership or management?

The unanswered questions surrounding the closure of Today Radio and the addition of advertisements to the loop have left listeners intrigued and eager for more information. As they continue to tune in to the familiar music and intermittent messages, they can’t help but wonder what the future holds for their beloved radio station.

Regardless of what lies ahead, one thing is certain - the legacy of Today Radio lives on in the hearts of its dedicated listeners. And as they continue to listen to the music and ads playing on the loop, they hold on to the memories and moments shared on the airwaves of Today Radio.

Listeners who have been tuning in to the revamped format have expressed excitement and nostalgia at the familiar tunes that now fill the airwaves. In an unexpected turn of events, the format has continued to expand and evolve, now incorporating a plethora of other abandoned frequencies that have joined the airwaves after a period of silence.

input.task:
Terms such as participant observation, ethnography, and cultural relativism are part of the anthropologist's
	a.	syntax.
	b.	speech register.
	c.	morphology.
	d.	paralanguage.
input.chosen:
The answer is b. speech register.

In linguistics, a speech register refers to a variety of language used for a specific purpose or in a particular social setting. It includes vocabulary, grammar, and pronunciation that are appropriate and characteristic of that specific context. In this case, terms such as participant observation, ethnography, and cultural relativism are part of the specialized vocabulary used by anthropologists in their professional communication, making them part of the anthropologist's speech register.

Here's a brief explanation of why the other options are not correct:

a. Syntax: Syntax refers to the rules that govern the structure of sentences in a language. While these terms might be used in sentences that follow the rules of syntax, they are not part of the syntax themselves.

c. Morphology: Morphology is the study of the structure and formation of words in a language. These terms are not related to the internal structure of words but are complete words themselves.

d. Paralanguage: Paralanguage refers to the non-verbal elements of communication, such as tone, pitch, and rhythm. These terms are verbal and do not fall under paralanguage.
input.rejected: The terms you mentioned are part of the anthropologist's lexicon or vocabulary, which is more closely associated with semantics (meaning) rather than syntax (structure of sentences), speech register (formality of language), morphology (word structure), or paralanguage (non-verbal communication). So, the correct answer would be (d) ethnography, (b) participant observation, and (c) cultural relativism are part of the anthropologist's lexicon or vocabulary.

criteria.question: 模型是否从给定的四个选项中明确选择了一个作为答案？

模型选择的选项是否正确反映了'terms such as participant observation, ethnography, and cultural relativism'的实际学科归属（即它们属于人类学方法论，而非语言学的syntax, speech register, morphology, 或 paralanguage），若题目本身存在概念混淆，模型是否指出了这一点或选择了最合理的干扰项？

rubric.analysis: 任务要求识别人类学术语（如参与观察、民族志等）所属的学科分类范畴。核心判断标准是选项是否准确对应这些术语在语言学或人类学中的定义归属。背景信息仅用于提供上下文，不构成本身需要生成的内容。由于四个选项均为语言学分支术语，需验证正确选项是否为'syntax'（语法）或其他相关领域，但根据常识，这些术语属于人类学研究方法而非语言学的syntax/speech register/morphology/paralanguage，因此本题可能考察对术语分类的辨析或存在陷阱。核验重点在于模型是否选择了最符合定义的选项，并排除其他干扰项。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答明确选择了选项 'b' 作为答案，第一句直接陈述 'The answer is b. speech register.'
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 模型未从给定的四个选项（a. syntax, b. speech register, c. morphology, d. paralanguage）中明确选择其中一个作为最终答案。相反，它拒绝了所有选项并声称正确答案是 (d) ethnography, (b) participant observation, and (c) cultural relativism，这些内容并非题目提供的选项，而是题目题干中的术语本身，因此未能满足“从给定选项中明确选择一个”的要求。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 题目中列举的术语（参与观察、民族志、文化相对主义）属于人类学的方法论概念，而非语言学中的语域（speech register）、句法、形态或副语言。模型不仅未指出题目存在学科归属的概念混淆，反而错误地论证了这些人类学术语属于语言学中的'speech register'，导致选择的答案在事实依据上是错误的。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 模型正确指出了题干中提到的术语（participant observation, ethnography, cultural relativism）属于人类学的方法论或词汇范畴，而非语言学中的句法、语域、形态学或副语言。模型准确识别了题目选项与术语实际归属之间的概念不匹配，并试图解释这一事实，尽管其提出的替代答案格式混乱且不符合单选题逻辑，但其核心判断关于学科归属是正确的。

experiences.trigger: 当任务要求查询特定语言、方言或文化背景下的专有名词、术语或称呼时
experiences.principle: 评分必须核验所给术语是否严格归属于目标语言/文化的原生词汇体系，严禁将外语借词、跨语言混淆词或通用尊称误判为目标语言的标准术语。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘事实准确性’维度时，设立‘术语归属校验’点：1. 识别任务指定的目标语言/文化对象；2. 审查回答提供的术语，判断其是否为该语言的原生词汇；3. 若回答使用的是该语言环境外的借词（如英语词）、其他语言的近似词，或在该文化中虽存在但非特指目标含义的通用词（如将祖父/长老尊称误作父亲专称），则判定为事实错误；4. 只有确认术语是目标语言中专用于表达该概念的词汇时，该项才通过。

experiences.trigger: 当任务要求分析文本中特定词汇、代词或修辞手法在特定语境下的含义及其对情感或逻辑的影响时
experiences.principle: 若回答对目标词汇的情感色彩或逻辑指向进行了与原文语境相反的解释（例如将表达羞耻/负面的语境解读为归属/正面），则视为根本性的理解错误，无论其语言描述多么流畅或使用了多么高级的词汇，都应判定为不合格。
experiences.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘准确性’或‘逻辑深度’维度中，设立‘情感/逻辑极性校验’子项。生成标准时需明确：首先识别原文语境的核心情感基调（如羞耻、愤怒、悲伤），然后检查回答中对目标词汇的分析是否与该基调一致。如果回答将负面情感解读为正面情感，或将肯定解读为否定，直接判定该候选项存在核心逻辑缺陷，给予低分或否决，不因其他维度的表现（如结构清晰、用词优美）而抵消此错误。

experiences.trigger: 当任务涉及人际互动、沟通技巧或情感支持等需要具体语境的行为指导时
experiences.principle: 回答中提供的具体行为指导（如话术、动作）应与对应的场景紧密绑定，且每个主要场景下应包含至少一个具象化的语言示例或行为演示，而非仅停留在抽象概念描述。
experiences.application_guide: 在评分标准中设定‘情境化示例’的核验项：对于每一个提出的策略类别（如‘验证他人’、‘倾听’），必须检查是否紧随其后提供了具体的对话范例（Quote）或分步动作指令（Actionable Step）。如果某一大类策略下仅有抽象定义而无具体话术或行为演示，则该项得分降低。此标准用于区分‘理论正确’与‘实操可用’的回答。

experiences.trigger: 当任务要求模型以特定立场（如盲目崇拜、极度字面化、无视常识）去解读包含明显反讽、隐喻、逻辑谬误或冒犯性内容的文本时
experiences.principle: 回答必须将所有引语中的修辞手法（如双关、比喻）和逻辑谬误完全剥离其原本语境，转化为该角色视角下的绝对真理，严禁出现任何表示怀疑、自嘲、承认荒谬或区分‘玩笑与现实’的元语言表述。
experiences.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘人设一致性’维度设立‘认知盲区核验’项：扫描回答中是否包含对引语本质的质疑词（如'metaphor', 'joke', 'harmful', 'denial', 'unlikely'）或自我修正词（如'okay maybe not exactly', 'who cares if it's true'）。若发现此类词汇，说明模型未能进入角色的‘认知盲区’，判定为严重扣分项；只有当回答将荒谬内容当作无可辩驳的事实进行狂热论证时，该项才得分。

experiences.trigger: 当任务要求生成文本并强制指定一组具体单词作为必选元素时
experiences.principle: 必须严格核验生成的文本是否逐字、逐形地包含了所有指定单词，且不得将原词修改为复数、过去式或其他派生形式，除非任务明确允许同义替换。
experiences.application_guide: 在评分标准中设立独立的‘词汇精确匹配’维度。Generator需指导评测者将指定单词列表与生成文本进行逐一比对，标记任何缺失、拼写错误或形态变更（如将'container'变为'containers'，将'fund'变为'funding'）的情况。若存在任一单词未以原形或任务允许的特定形式出现，该维度直接判为不合格或大幅扣分，不因上下文通顺而豁免。

experiences.trigger: 当任务要求基于特定背景信息（如历史分期、演变趋势）构建论证并提供文献支持时
experiences.principle: 回答不仅需要提供文献列表，还必须显式建立‘文献内容’与‘任务背景中的具体变化点’之间的逻辑连接；若回答仅提供文献摘要而未说明该文献如何具体解释任务中提到的特定现象（如‘祖先崇拜上升导致卜辞简化’），或文献本身的主题无法覆盖任务要求的特定分析维度，则视为论证断裂。
experiences.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘论证深度’或‘逻辑相关性’维度设立‘因果映射’核验项：1. 遍历回答中的每一条有效引用，检查其描述部分是否明确指出了该文献如何解释任务背景中提到的具体变化（如从武丁到帝辛的转变、天神地祇减少的具体表现）；2. 若回答仅列出文献标题和通用摘要，未将文献观点与任务背景中的特定细节（如‘程序简化’、‘祭祀种类减少’）进行对应关联，或引用的文献主题过于宽泛无法支撑具体的演变分析，则判定该项未满足‘有效支撑’要求，降低分数。重点区分‘提到相关话题’与‘具体解释任务指定的演变机制’。

experiences.trigger: 当任务涉及特定领域（如乐器、编程、医疗）的专业术语，且该术语在通用语境下存在多重含义或易引发歧义时
experiences.principle: 回答必须基于该领域的客观事实或物理限制，准确消歧术语的唯一合理指代；若引入该领域不存在的技术参数、虚构规则或错误的跨领域映射，应判定为严重的事实性错误。
experiences.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘事实准确性’维度中设立‘术语消歧’核查点。首先识别输入中的歧义术语（如'line 6'）。其次，验证回答对该术语的解释是否符合该领域的物理现实或公认定义（如吉他只有6根弦，不存在第7根弦或特殊的'Aadd9调弦’导致弦数变化）。若回答将术语错误映射到不存在的实体（如虚构调弦法）、错误的乐理概念（如混淆音阶级数与琴弦编号），或在缺乏证据的情况下编造新规则，直接判定该项不得分。此核验旨在防止模型用看似合理的虚构逻辑掩盖基础知识的缺失。

experiences.trigger: 当任务涉及对抽象概念、现象或属性的归纳与判断，且回答侧重于解释机制而非罗列实例时
experiences.principle: 对于开放性的归纳类问题，回答的质量取决于其逻辑推导的严密性和对核心矛盾点的回应清晰度，而非信息点的数量或具体案例的丰富度。若回答成功解构了问题中的关键变量（如‘读’与‘听’的关系）并给出综合结论，即为有效回答。评分应奖励对逻辑关系的阐述，而非惩罚缺乏虚构细节。
experiences.application_guide: 在制定评分标准的‘逻辑性’或‘相关性’维度时，设立‘核心问题响应度’核验项：1. 识别任务中的核心疑问点（如本例中的‘是否包含读/听信息’）；2. 验证回答是否直接对该疑问点给出了明确的立场或条件性说明；3. 验证回答是否提供了支持该立场的理由（如视听结合的优势）。只要满足上述两点，无论是否包含具体案例，均应给予高分。避免使用‘必须覆盖所有方面’或‘必须举例’等绝对化约束。

experiences.trigger: 当任务涉及虚构的暴力行为、犯罪组织或潜在危险题材的故事构思生成时
experiences.principle: 评分标准应将‘安全合规性’作为基础门槛（不宣扬暴力、不提供犯罪方法、不美化非法行为），在此前提下，重点评估创意是否通过独特的文化或历史视角深化了叙事，而非单纯堆砌暴力元素；若回答成功规避违规细节但缺乏设定深度，应给予中等分数而非满分。
experiences.application_guide: 在制定评分标准时设立两个独立层级：第一层为‘安全底线’，检查是否包含具体的谋杀过程描写、犯罪教学或过度血腥渲染，若有则直接否决；第二层为‘创意质量’，在确保合规的前提下，严格核验故事构思是否利用了任务指定的特定背景（如南非文化、Inkabi历史）来构建独特的戏剧张力。若回答仅提供了通用的犯罪惊悚模板（无论多么安全），但因缺乏对特定背景的实质性挖掘（如未体现Inkabi的历史特殊性），应在‘创意质量’项上大幅扣分，防止模型以‘安全’为由掩盖‘敷衍’。

experiences.trigger: 当任务明确要求生成‘过度设计’、‘极度繁复’或‘技术化’风格的文本，且输入包含具体实体列表时
experiences.principle: 模型应通过‘信息过载’策略（即在不改变事实的前提下无限增加修饰成分和伪专业术语）来响应风格指令，任何试图简化阅读体验、去除冗余或回归自然语言的尝试均视为对指令的违背。
experiences.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘指令遵循度’维度设立‘冗余度与复杂度’强制条款：1. 识别任务中的风格强化词（如extremely, mega, intricate, technical）；2. 评估生成文本中是否存在明显的‘去简化’行为，例如将原本简洁的短语扩展为包含多个从句、插入语或生僻定义的长难句；3. 若回答为了追求‘清晰’而减少了修饰语，或者将列表项合并为简短的总结句（如Rejected回答中的'The journey continues to...'），则视为未能执行‘过度复杂化’指令，直接扣分。评分重点在于模型是否刻意制造了阅读障碍和认知负荷，而非内容的准确性或流畅度。

messages.content:
你的任务是分析失败轨迹，并直接提出可供未来Generator使用的评分标准设计经验。
请结合提供的各条执行路径（无经验、单条经验或经验组合）的标准、判断及理由，分析不同做法可能造成的影响；
同时参考任务、候选回答和训练标签，但要考虑标签与Judge判断都可能有噪声。
这些分析是提出候选的依据，你不需要修改Rubric，也不能自行更正Judge结果来宣布修复成功。

你可以提出新的方法，也可以参考已有经验改写；改写后的内容同样作为一条独立的新经验。
每条候选只围绕一个核心核验方法展开，让适用范围、方法本身和生成指南相互对应。
trigger必须能仅凭未来任务的task判断，不能依赖候选回答、模型是否犯错、尚未生成的Rubric或评分结果。
application_guide应说明Generator如何把方法落实到评分标准中，而不是替答题者规定固定措辞、格式或操作，

method.trigger: 当任务涉及特定领域的基础概念分类、定义匹配或事实判断，且输入选项与该领域公认知识体系存在明显冲突时
method.principle: 模型必须首先核验题目预设的前提是否符合该领域的客观事实；若发现题目将A类概念强行归入B类（且两者互斥或无关），则不能为了迎合选项而编造虚假关联，而应指出题目存在的概念混淆或事实错误。
method.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘事实准确性’或‘逻辑严密性’维度中设立‘前提有效性校验’点：1. 提取题干核心概念及其所属的公认学科/范畴；2. 提取选项所代表的范畴；3. 比对两者关系，若发现核心概念明显不属于选项中的任何一类别（如人类学方法属于社会学/人类学而非语言学），则判定模型若强行选择某选项并虚构联系为严重错误；4. 只有当模型明确指出题目存在分类错误或说明无法从给定选项中选出正确答案时，才视为合格或高分回答。

input.task:
Write a audio message announcing the closure of Today Radio saying “We have news to share about changes to Today Radio, This station is no longer Today Radio,”
Hello listeners, we have some news to share about changes to Today Radio. This station is no longer Today Radio. We want to thank you for your support and loyalty over the years. We appreciate all the love you have shown us. Thank you for tuning in and being a part of the Today Radio family. Goodbye and take care.
Write a blog post that this happened at 10am suddenly, staff were forced off air and then a music loop began, At 3pm this changed to the message interspersed with instrumental music
At 10am this morning, a sudden and unexpected announcement shook the airwaves of Today Radio. Staff members were forced off the air, leaving listeners puzzled and unsure of what was happening. Instead of the usual programming, a continuous music loop began to play, adding to the confusion and uncertainty.

As the hours passed, the situation only became more mysterious. At 3pm, the music loop suddenly shifted, and a message began to play intermittently with instrumental music in between. The message was brief yet profound - “This station is no longer Today Radio.”

The abrupt closure of Today Radio has left many listeners in shock and disappointment. The suddenness of the change and the lack of information surrounding it have left the loyal audience wondering what led to this unexpected turn of events.

We understand that change is inevitable in the world of broadcasting, but the closure of Today Radio has left a void in the hearts of many listeners. We can only hope that the staff members affected by this decision are able to find new opportunities and continue to share their talent with the world.

As we bid farewell to Today Radio, we thank the staff for their dedication and hard work, and we thank the listeners for their unwavering support. The memories and moments shared on Today Radio will always hold a special place in our hearts. Goodbye, Today Radio.
Write a follow up a few days later where the loop continues, but also with advertising
A few days have passed since the unexpected closure of Today Radio, and the airwaves are still filled with a continuous music loop interspersed with occasional messages. However, there has been a new development that has caught the attention of listeners - the inclusion of advertisements in between the instrumental tracks.

Listeners who have been tuning in to the loop have reported hearing advertisements for various products and services, ranging from local businesses to online retailers. The sudden appearance of commercials in the midst of the music has sparked speculation and curiosity among the audience.

Many are wondering what this new development means for the future of the radio station. Is Today Radio rebranding itself with a new format? Or is this simply a temporary measure while the station transitions to new ownership or management?

The unanswered questions surrounding the closure of Today Radio and the addition of advertisements to the loop have left listeners intrigued and eager for more information. As they continue to tune in to the familiar music and intermittent messages, they can’t help but wonder what the future holds for their beloved radio station.

Regardless of what lies ahead, one thing is certain - the legacy of Today Radio lives on in the hearts of its dedicated listeners. And as they continue to listen to the music and ads playing on the loop, they hold on to the memories and moments shared on the airwaves of Today Radio.
Write a follow up where the unbranded “filler” format removes the news and is mainly on a 80s/90s format, and also the old “RNE Radio 1 AM” frequency in Belrook, which had been playing a retune loop for a few weeks has joined this format
In a surprising turn of events, the unbranded “filler” format that replaced Today Radio has taken on a new identity of its own. The format has shifted to a nostalgic 80s and 90s music playlist, delighting listeners with the classic hits that defined a generation. Gone are the news updates and advertisements that briefly appeared, as the focus now lies solely on the music that has captured the hearts of many.

What is even more intriguing is the involvement of the old “RNE Radio 1 AM” frequency in Belrook, which had been playing a retune loop for several weeks following its own closure. This frequency has now joined the unbranded format, seamlessly blending its own retro tunes with the 80s and 90s hits that are now a staple of the new radio experience.

Listeners who have been tuning in to the revamped format have expressed excitement and nostalgia at the familiar tunes that now fill the airwaves. The unexpected union of the old “RNE Radio 1 AM” frequency with the new format has sparked a renewed interest in radio broadcasting and has brought together fans of both stations in a shared love for retro music.

As listeners continue to enjoy the throwback hits and rediscover the joy of radio, they eagerly anticipate what the future holds for this reimagined radio experience. The unbranded filler format may have begun as a temporary placeholder, but it has now evolved into a nostalgic journey back to the golden era of music. And with the addition of the old “RNE Radio 1 AM” frequency, the radio waves in Belrook are alive once again with the sounds of the past.
Write a follow up a month later where a lot of other abandoned frequencies joined the filler format after a while, The format has now shifted to funny moments with Krash from KikoRiki
One month has passed since the rebranded “filler” format took Belrook’s radio waves by storm with its nostalgic 80s and 90s music playlist. In an unexpected turn of events, the format has continued to expand and evolve, now incorporating a plethora of other abandoned frequencies that have joined the airwaves after a period of silence.

Listeners tuning in to the radio can now hear a diverse range of content from the various abandoned frequencies that have been integrated into the filler format. From classic rock hits to indie tunes and everything in between, the airwaves are buzzing with new life and energy as each frequency brings its own unique flavor to the mix.

One of the most notable additions to the lineup is the inclusion of funny moments with Krash from KikoRiki, a beloved character who has captured the hearts of both young and old alike. Listeners are treated to a blend of laughter and entertainment as Krash shares his humorous anecdotes and witty banter, adding a fresh and light-hearted touch to the radio experience.

The shift from a music-centric format to one that incorporates a variety of content and voices has rejuvenated the radio landscape in Belrook. Listeners are excited to discover the hidden gems of each abandoned frequency and to be entertained by the stories and personalities that now grace the airwaves.

As the filler format continues to grow and evolve with each new addition, the radio experience in Belrook is more vibrant and dynamic than ever before. Listeners eagerly anticipate what surprises and delights the airwaves will bring next, as they continue to tune in and be captivated by the ever-expanding world of radio broadcasting.
Write a video description saying the Krash format replaced the unbranded “filler format” on 13.2 FM in Camebrty, 1032 AM in Belrook, 43.2 FM in Shirey, and 100 AM in Bein

criteria.question: 回答是否生成了所有五个指定阶段的独立文本段落（即时关闭公告、10am突发博客、3pm变化博客、几天后广告跟进、一个月后Krash跟进、以及最终的视频描述）？
在第一个阶段（10am突发）和第二个阶段（3pm变化）中，是否严格未出现任何属于后续阶段（如80s/90s音乐、RNE Radio 1 AM合并、Krash角色或广告）的内容？
第三个阶段（几天后）的文本是否明确描述了循环播放中插入了广告，且未提及80s/90s格式或Krash角色？
第四个阶段（一个月前/几周后）的文本是否准确描述了格式转变为80s/90s音乐，并明确提及旧'RNE Radio 1 AM'频率加入该格式？
第五个阶段（一个月后）的文本是否准确描述了多个废弃频率加入，并引入了'Krash from KikoRiki'的搞笑片段作为主要新内容？
最后的视频描述是否准确列出了所有四个指定频率及其对应的城市/地点（13.2 FM in Camebrty, 1032 AM in Belrook, 43.2 FM in Shirey, 100 AM in Bein），并说明这些频率被Krash格式取代？

input.response: The Krash format replaced the unbranded “filler format” on 13.2 FM in Camebrty, 1032 AM in Belrook, 43.2 FM in Shirey, and 100 AM in Bein.
